name: UserTrail
summary: Website behaviour analytics: heatmaps, session replays, funnels, form analytics, journeys and on-site surveys from one tracking script, with a free plan to start.
best_for: small and mid-sized websites that want heatmaps, session replays, funnels and form analytics in one tool, with a free plan to try it on real traffic
skip_if: you run high-traffic sites well beyond 100,000 sessions a month, need more than 12 months of history, or cannot accept tracking pausing when the allowance runs out
honest_knock: The session allowance is shared across all websites on a plan, and when it runs out tracking pauses until the monthly refill, so a traffic spike can end your recordings for the rest of the month. Lower plans also cap a single recording at 5 or 10 minutes and keep data for 1 or 6 months. UserTrail is a young product with little public track record, and monthly billing costs about 20% more than the yearly price. We have not used UserTrail ourselves.

pricing.entry_price_terms: Basic · per month billed yearly, 10,000 sessions and 3 websites
pricing.plans_source: summarised from pricing.notes; every plan name and amount appears verbatim in those notes
pricing.notes: (read 2026-10-07 on usertrail.io/pricing in a browser render, USD, with both the yearly and the monthly toggle) Four plans, priced by monthly sessions. Free is $0 forever: 500 sessions a month, 1 website, sessions up to 5 minutes and 1 month of data retention. Basic is $39 a month billed yearly or $47 billed monthly: 10,000 sessions, 3 websites, 10-minute sessions, 6 months of retention. Standard, marked Popular, is $78 yearly or $94 monthly: 50,000 sessions, 10 websites, 20-minute sessions, 9 months of retention. Professional is $117 yearly or $140 monthly: 100,000 sessions, 25 websites, 30-minute sessions, 12 months of retention. The plan table lists click and scroll heatmaps, session replays, real-time data, move and attention heatmaps, funnels, surveys, form analytics, journey analytics, unlimited users and user permissions. The paid plans have a 14-day free trial without a card. The FAQ says the session allowance is shared across all websites on the plan and that tracking pauses when it runs out until the monthly refill, and that first-time annual subscribers can get a full refund within 14 days.

free_plan_evidence: Free is $0 forever: 500 sessions a month, 1 website, sessions up to 5 minutes and 1 month of data retention.

compare_with.name: Crazy Egg
compare_with.why: Crazy Egg is in our dossiers too and also sells heatmaps and recordings to site owners. UserTrail puts heatmaps, replays, funnels, form analytics, journeys and surveys on every paid plan and adds a free plan with 500 sessions a month; compare the two on how many sessions you really record a month and on what happens when the allowance runs out.
